places.name: UAE Flower Farm
places.description: An open-field flower farm in the mountains of Wadi Asimah with tens of thousands of blooms: sunflowers, snapdragons, gladioli and lavender. Open seasonally, roughly late December to March; small entry fee, and you can pick and buy your own bouquet.

places.name: Cactus Farm Asimah
places.description: The UAE's largest cactus collection: more than 5,000 cacti and succulents of over 1,000 species in greenhouses and outdoor beds, grown by Emirati collector Obaid Al Mazroui. Open to visitors; easy to combine with the flower farm in the same valley.
